name: arXiv Search
label: arXiv - Preprint Repository Search
description: Search and fetch arXiv preprints through the official Atom API at http://export.arxiv.org/api/query (HTTP, not HTTPS). Completely free: no API key, no OAuth, no configuration secret. EXACT input.action values (case-sensitive): 'search' | 'get_paper'. 'search' (default) requires query (alias q) and optionally wraps it as cat:{category} AND ({query}) when category is non-empty; output.query is always the original unwrapped string. 'get_paper' requires arxiv_id (single; wins) or arxiv_ids (JSON array or comma-separated string). max_results default 50, hard-capped at 100 (Python handler; ignore older copy that said default 10). sort_by EXACT: 'relevance' | 'lastUpdatedDate' | 'submittedDate' (default relevance). sort_order EXACT: 'descending' | 'ascending' (default descending). start is a 0-based pagination offset. Each papers[] item exposes abstract (NOT summary), plus arxiv_id, title, authors, published, updated, doi, journal_ref, primary_category, categories, comment, url, pdf_url. Responses are Atom XML parsed in-process (JDK DocumentBuilder, XXE-hardened). arXiv rate-limits at roughly one request every 3 seconds; this node does not sleep — space calls in the workflow. Example: {"action":"search","query":"ti:\"attention is all you need\"","category":"cs.CL","max_results":5}.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One object of search or lookup parameters. Delivered as inputVariables.input (or currentNode.inputList targetPortValue=input). The handler unwraps a one-element list. Fields: action, query (alias q), arxiv_id, arxiv_ids, category, max_results, sort_by, sort_order, start. Unknown keys are ignored. Example: {"action":"search","query":"au:hinton","max_results":10,"sort_by":"submittedDate","sort_order":"descending","start":0}.

schema.label: Action
schema.description: Which arXiv API operation to run. EXACT accepted values (case-sensitive, no aliases): 'search' | 'get_paper'. 'search' (default when omitted, blank, or the string 'null') runs GET search_query/start/max_results/sortBy/sortOrder and returns papers plus total_results. 'get_paper' runs GET id_list={comma-joined ids}&max_results={len(ids)} and returns those papers. Any other string fails before the HTTP call with error 'Unknown action: {action}. Use 'search' or 'get_paper'.'. Example: 'search'.

schema.label: Query
schema.description: Search expression for action='search'. REQUIRED for search; missing/blank/null fails with 'query is required for search action.'. Alias: the handler also reads input.q when query is blank (Python `query or q`). Supports arXiv field prefixes: ti: (title), au: (author), abs: (abstract), cat: (category), all:, co: (comment), jr: (journal ref). Quotes and Boolean AND/OR/ANDNOT are passed through to arXiv. Ignored for get_paper. When category is also set, the HTTP search_query becomes cat:{category} AND ({query}) but output.query stays this original string. Example: 'ti:"graph neural network" AND au:kipf'.

schema.label: arXiv ID
schema.description: Single paper id for action='get_paper'. When this field is non-blank, it OVERWRITES arxiv_ids to a one-element list (Python: `if arxiv_id: arxiv_ids = [arxiv_id]`), including when arxiv_ids was already set. Accepts new-style ids ('2301.07041', '2301.07041v2') or old-style ('hep-ex/0307015'). Do not include the https://arxiv.org/abs/ prefix; the handler will still parse it out of Atom <id> on the way back. Ignored for search. Example: '1706.03762'.

schema.label: arXiv IDs
schema.description: Batch ids for action='get_paper' when arxiv_id is absent. Designer type is string, but the handler accepts either a comma-separated string OR a JSON array of strings (DataNodeSupport.stringList). Tokens are trimmed; empty tokens dropped. If both this and arxiv_id are empty, get_paper fails with 'arxiv_id or arxiv_ids is required for get_paper action.'. HTTP id_list is the ids joined with commas (no spaces) and max_results=len(ids). Example string: '2301.07041,1706.03762'. Example array: ["2301.07041","hep-ex/0307015"].

schema.label: Category
schema.description: Optional arXiv archive.category for action='search' only. When non-empty, the outbound search_query is wrapped as cat:{category} AND ({query}); output.category echoes this value and output.query stays unwrapped. When omitted, output.category is null. Empty string is not wrapped. Use taxonomy codes from https://arxiv.org/category_taxonomy (e.g. 'cs.AI', 'cs.CL', 'cs.LG', 'stat.ML', 'math.CO', 'physics.gen-ph', 'hep-th', 'q-bio.NC'). Not an enum in the handler — invalid codes yield zero hits from arXiv, not a node error. Ignored for get_paper. Example: 'cs.CL'.

schema.label: Max Results
schema.description: Page size for action='search'. Default: 50 (Python; not 10). Hard cap: min(max_results, 100) before the GET. Sent as the arXiv max_results query param. For get_paper this input is ignored; the handler sends max_results=len(ids) instead. Combine with start for paging (page k uses start=k*max_results). Example: 25. Do not set above 100 — extra is discarded.

schema.label: Sort By
schema.description: arXiv sortBy for action='search'. EXACT accepted values (case-sensitive, forwarded as sortBy): 'relevance' | 'lastUpdatedDate' | 'submittedDate'. Default when omitted/blank: 'relevance'. The handler does not rewrite unknown values; arXiv will reject or ignore them. Ignored for get_paper. Example: 'submittedDate'.

schema.label: Sort Order
schema.description: arXiv sortOrder for action='search'. EXACT accepted values (case-sensitive, forwarded as sortOrder): 'descending' | 'ascending'. Default when omitted/blank: 'descending'. The handler does not rewrite unknown values. Ignored for get_paper. Example: 'descending'.

schema.label: Start Index
schema.description: Zero-based offset into the arXiv result set for action='search'. Default: 0. Sent as the start query param (not a 1-based page number). total_results in the output is the corpus size; papers_returned is this page. Example: start=50 with max_results=50 returns the second page. Ignored for get_paper.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Single JSON object. Success search: {status:'ok', action:'search', query, category, total_results, papers_returned, start, papers}. Success get_paper: {status:'ok', action:'get_paper', papers_returned, papers}. papers[].abstract is the Atom summary with whitespace collapsed — there is no summary field. Example success: {"status":"ok","action":"search","query":"graph","category":null,"total_results":1200,"papers_returned":5,"start":0,"papers":[{"arxiv_id":"1706.03762","title":"Attention Is All You Need","abstract":"..."}]}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on success only. EXACT value: 'ok'. Absent when the object is a failure ({error} only). Do not treat missing status as ok. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Action
schema.description: Echo of the action that succeeded. EXACT values: 'search' | 'get_paper'. Present on success only. Example: 'search'.

schema.label: Query
schema.description: Present on action='search' success. The original input query (or q), NOT the cat:{category} AND (...) wrapper that was sent to arXiv. Example: 'ti:"transformer"'.

schema.label: Category
schema.description: Present on action='search' success. Echo of input.category: the string that was sent, or null when the field was omitted. Empty string is echoed as empty string. Example: 'cs.AI'.

schema.label: Papers Returned
schema.description: Count of papers[] after dropping Atom entries with an empty title. Integer. May be less than max_results (or less than id_list length) when arXiv returns fewer hits or some entries have no title. Example: 5.

schema.label: Total Results
schema.description: Present on action='search' success. OpenSearch totalResults from the Atom feed (http://a9.com/-/spec/opensearch/1.1/) — the full corpus size matching search_query, not this page. Integer; 0 when the element is missing or empty. Absent on get_paper. Use with start and max_results to page. Example: 18420.

schema.label: Start Index
schema.description: Present on action='search' success. Echo of the start offset that was requested (default 0). Absent on get_paper. Example: 0.

schema.label: Papers
schema.description: Array of paper objects parsed from Atom <entry>. Empty array when the query matched nothing or every entry lacked a title. Field names match Python: use abstract, never summary. Each element: arxiv_id, title, authors[], abstract, published, updated, doi, journal_ref, primary_category, categories[], comment, url, pdf_url.

children.label: arXiv ID
children.description: Id parsed from Atom <id>. If the text contains '/abs/', the suffix after '/abs/' is kept (e.g. http://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762v1 → 1706.03762v1; http://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ex/0307015 → hep-ex/0307015). Otherwise the raw id text. Example: '1706.03762v1'.

children.label: Title
children.description: Atom <title> with internal whitespace collapsed to single spaces (DataNodeSupport.collapseWs). Entries whose collapsed title is empty are skipped and do not appear in papers[]. Example: 'Attention Is All You Need'.

children.label: Authors
children.description: Ordered list of Atom author/name strings, trimmed. Empty array when the entry has no authors. Example: ["Ashish Vaswani","Noam Shazeer"].

children.label: Abstract
children.description: Atom <summary> with whitespace collapsed. This is the abstract. There is NO summary field in the output object — Python named it abstract. Example: 'The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks...'.

children.label: Published
children.description: Atom <published> timestamp as returned by arXiv (typically ISO-8601 UTC). Empty string when missing. Example: '2017-06-12T17:57:34Z'.

children.label: Updated
children.description: Atom <updated> timestamp as returned by arXiv. Empty string when missing. Example: '2023-08-02T00:00:00Z'.

children.label: DOI
children.description: arxiv:doi text in namespace http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom. Empty string when the paper has no DOI. Example: '10.5555/3295222.3295349'.

children.label: Journal Ref
children.description: arxiv:journal_ref text. Empty string when absent. Example: 'Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 30 (2017)'.

children.label: Primary Category
children.description: arxiv:primary_category @term. Empty string when absent. Example: 'cs.CL'.

children.label: Categories
children.description: Every Atom <category @term> on the entry, including the primary. Empty array when none. Example: ["cs.CL","cs.LG"].

children.label: Comment
children.description: arxiv:comment text (page counts, conference notes). Empty string when absent. Example: '15 pages, 5 figures, NIPS 2017'.

children.label: URL
children.description: Abstract landing page, always https://arxiv.org/abs/{arxiv_id} (HTTPS abs URL, not the Atom id). Example: 'https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762v1'.

children.label: PDF URL
children.description: Atom <link title="pdf" href> when present; otherwise https://arxiv.org/pdf/{arxiv_id}. title matching is exact 'pdf' (case-sensitive, Python). Example: 'http://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.03762v1'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout in seconds for the single GET to http://export.arxiv.org/api/query. Default: 30. Missing, zero, or non-positive values fall back to 30 (the shared HTTP helper requires a positive timeout). On expiry the output is {error:'arXiv API Error: timed out after {n}s'}. Keep this at or below the daemon stateful request budget (default 300s) or the sandbox is killed first. Instance-editable. Example: 30. This is not an inter-request delay — do not use it to pace arXiv's ~3s rate limit; space node invocations in the workflow instead.
